messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — first day! Quick question about security onboarding: I got the LMS invite but I'm wondering whether I should enroll my personal Mac into Redwood MDM or request a company laptop? Also curious how the phishing sims work so I don't accidentally fail anything. Thanks!

People Ops: Welcome, Maya :tada: If you can take a company laptop that's easiest — request here: https://intranet.redwood.com/hardware and tag @IT Support. If you prefer personal device it's allowed but must be enrolled in Redwood MDM, have FileVault/BitLocker on, a strong passcode, and disk encryption enabled. Training must be completed within 7 days.

IT Support: Hi Maya — to enroll a Mac, open Self Service -> Install "Redwood MDM" or run the installer:```/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://mdm.redwood.com/install.sh)"``` After install, reboot and confirm your device shows up in Okta Device Trust. If you run into errors, DM me and I'll remote in.

Jamal Ortiz: FYI on phishing sims: we'll be running a targeted simulation next week for new hires (0-14 days). Sim emails will include "[PHISH-SIM]" in the subject line and may contain tracking links. Treat them like real phishing attempts — don't click links or enter credentials. Use the "Report Phish" button in the mail client or forward to security@redwood.com if unsure. Completion of the security training reduces your chance of being targeted.

People Ops: Action items: 1) If you want a laptop, submit hardware request. 2) If using personal, run MDM installer and confirm. 3) Finish the 1hr LMS course and upload a screenshot to the onboarding form (we also auto-track completions).

PhishSim Bot: Scheduled: Phishing simulation for new hires on Tue 2026-03-31 10:00 PDT. Targets: new-hires (0-14 days).

Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll request a company laptop for now. One follow-up: is the password manager invite automatic or do I need to request access?

People Ops: We'll send a 1Password invite to your work email within ~30m. It comes from admin@1password.com — check spam if you don't see it. If you're on a personal device and enroll MDM, 1Password will be allowed after device checks pass.

IT Support: If the installer fails with a permissions error, try running:```sudo /usr/local/redwood/mdm_agent enroll --token <token-from-okta>``` Otherwise ping me here and we can pair. If you need a temporary loaner, reply with "loaner" and @People Ops will coordinate.

Maya Patel: Great, thanks everyone! I'll submit the hardware request and finish the training today. :slightly_smiling_face:
